On October 6, 2023, I gave the final report on the discussion paper I am writing as a visiting researcher at the CPRC, at a CPRC workshop. I received many helpful comments, not only from legal scholars but also from economists.

It has taken me quite a long time and I need to finish it soon; I will do my best to complete it in the first half of fiscal 2024.
